question: Who among the following Indian Classical dancers received the National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aparna Satheesan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aparna Satheesan** is an acclaimed Indian classical dancer known for her proficiency in Bharatanatyam and Mohiniyattam.
 
• She was honored with the **National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022** for her outstanding contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• The award recognizes her dedication, skill, and efforts in promoting and preserving the rich heritage of Indian classical dance forms.
 
• Apart from her dance performances, Aparna Satheesan is also involved in teaching and mentoring young dancers, contributing to the future of classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Nritya Shiromani Award** is a prestigious recognition given to exceptional dancers who have made significant contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• It aims to honor and encourage artists who have shown excellence in their field and have worked towards the preservation and promotion of classical dance traditions.
 
• Previous recipients of the award include renowned dancers such as **Padma Subrahmanyam** and **Alarmel Valli**.
 
• Indian classical dance encompasses various forms such as **Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, and Mohiniyattam**, each with its unique style and cultural significance.
 
• The recognition of artists like Aparna Satheesan highlights the importance of cultural heritage and the role of dance in India's rich artistic tradition.
